_comment: Written by the trading runs (9:30a / hourly / 3:30p ET). Never contains account numbers, broker IDs, or any account other than the sandbox.

account.note: PULLED LIVE AT 12:21 ET AGAINST THE MANDATED ACCOUNT BY THE HOURLY RUN. Portfolio, equity positions and option positions were each queried live and all three returned first time: 1009.16 total, 1009.16 cash, zero equity value, zero options value, zero pending deposits and ZERO unsettled, with buying_power reading 1009.16 to match. BOTH POSITION LISTS ARE EMPTY, which discharges the exit step rather than excusing it: no target, stop, time stop or option no-fly window is reachable because no position carries one. ZERO equity orders on a created_at floor of 2026-08-22, so the broker itself - not the empty position list - is what establishes that the 09:49 specification has not been executed. THE WHOLE BALANCE IS SETTLED, so the whole of it is deployable and no good-faith violation is reachable. ONE SPECIFICATION IS LIVE AGAINST IT AND IT IS RE-QUOTED AND CONFIRMED FOR THE THIRD HOUR: 2 SMTC at a 138.50 limit, costing at most 277.00 - 27.4% of the account, inside the 40% single-name ceiling, leaving 732.16 uncommitted. THE HOUR'S FINDING: THE LEVEL IS STILL BID FOR AND THE NAME HAS STOPPED FALLING. SMTC is 137.61 bid / 138.00 ask at 16:21:54.761024537Z - one cent higher than an hour ago - so the limit is still 0.50 above the offer and still immediately marketable. It has now printed at or under 138.50 for 82 consecutive minute bars, 88 on the session, and the 12:10 bar retested the 136.500 session low at 136.5383 without breaking it. All three invalidations were tested mechanically and none tripped, though every buffer narrowed: 3.90 on the 132.60 print test, 5.27 on the NVDA 205.00 test, and 2.99 on the 134.00 five-minute-close test after the lowest completed close moved down to 136.990 at 12:05. The limit is neither raised nor lowered - explicitly not lowered to 136.50 to catch the double bottom, because improving an entry after the fact is chasing one with the sign flipped.

entryWatch.setup: SMTC post-earnings day 1 - reported 8/25 after the close, SPECIFIED at 09:49 at a 138.50 limit for 2 shares, FORCED on items 2 and 3, RE-QUOTED AND CONFIRMED at 10:22, 11:22 and again at 12:21
entryWatch.trigger: STILL LIVE AT 138.50, QUOTES CURRENT, INVALIDATIONS UNTOUCHED - AND THE NAME HAS STOPPED FALLING ON THE EXACT SHELF THE ENTRY WAS STRUCK AT. SMTC is 137.61 bid / 138.00 ask at 2026-08-26T16:21:54.761024537Z, last 137.850, +8.10% against the 127.520 settled close, on a 0.28% spread. In the hour since the last confirm the bid has moved ONE CENT, 137.60 to 137.61. THE LIMIT REMAINS IMMEDIATELY MARKETABLE RATHER THAN RESTING: at 138.50 it sits 0.50 ABOVE the offer, so an operator executing now fills at 138.00 or better, inside the limit, with the 127.42 stop and 166.20 target struck off a price never paid. IT HAS BEEN AT OR UNDER THE LIMIT FOR 82 CONSECUTIVE MINUTE BARS, 11:00 ET straight through to 12:21, and 88 minutes on the session counting the first touch in the 10:23 bar. What is new this hour is not weakness but the absence of it: the 11:03 low of 136.500 and the 12:10 low of 136.5383 bracket eighty minutes of two-way trade between roughly 136.50 and 138.85, on volume collapsed to two- and three-thousand-share minutes from the thirty- and forty-thousand-share minutes of the give-back. THAT RANGE IS THE 137.50-138.24 SHELF THE 09:49 ENTRY NAMED. The setup described at publication is the setup on the tape. ALL THREE PRE-REGISTERED INVALIDATIONS TESTED MECHANICALLY AT 12:21 AND NONE TRIPPED, with every buffer narrower or equal. FIRST, a print below 132.60: NOT TRIPPED. The lowest post-publication print is still 136.500, 3.90 clear, unchanged - but the 12:10 bar retested it at 136.5383, three and a half cents above, on 3,033 shares. Two lows within four cents seventy minutes apart is the level being defended; the written test still reads NOT TRIPPED and that is what decides. SECOND, NVDA below 205.00: NOT TRIPPED at 210.27 bid, 5.27 clear against 5.67 an hour ago and 5.70 at 10:22 - the third consecutive hour of erosion and the only one of the three moving monotonically, into a print that lands tonight rather than on the tape. THIRD, a five-minute close below 134.00 on rising volume: NOT TRIPPED, and this is the test that actually moved. The lowest completed post-publication five-minute close is now 136.990 in the 12:05 bucket, displacing the 137.220 of 11:00, so the buffer narrows to 2.99 from 3.22. The volume half was checked rather than assumed - 15,713 shares against 15,360 in the prior bucket, up 2.3%, flat - and the price half fails by 2.99 on its own. THE FOURTH TEST WAS RULED ON AT 11:22 AGAINST THE GATE AND IS APPLIED HERE RATHER THAN RE-ARGUED: the inside-the-spread kill lives in the option branch of scripts/validate.mjs only, because this rulebook buys with limits struck UNDER the market at levels the tape must return to, and for a buy a limit above the offer means marketable, not stale. THE LIMIT IS NEITHER RAISED NOR LOWERED. Not raised, because there is nothing to chase - the market is below it. NOT LOWERED TO 136.50 to catch the double bottom either, and that is this hour's live temptation rather than a hypothetical one: two clean tests of the same low is precisely the evidence that would justify a better entry, and improving an entry after the fact is chasing one with the sign flipped. 189 MINUTES REMAIN ON THE 15:30 FUSE. If SMTC is never bought this expires as the fifteenth consecutive unexecuted entry and the first to die with its named level having genuinely traded, at length and on volume - a delivery failure rather than a thesis failure.
entryWatch.why: FORCED ON ITEMS 2 AND 3 AND CLEAN ON THE OTHER FOUR. Item 1 is a 24.6% beat - Q2 EPS 0.71 against a 0.57 estimate, verified on a live calendar pull. Item 5 is the reason it ranks first and it is the strongest on the board: SMTC was marked DOWN 21.6% into its own print, 154.22 on 8/17 to a 120.91 close on 8/24, on 8,904,562 shares on 8/25 against a ~2.3M average - expectations cut into the report, not raised into it - and the beat came in bigger than the markdown, with the 138.50 limit still 10.2% below the 8/17 high. Item 4 passes on a 0.17% spread and 45k-82k share minutes through the breakout. ITEM 2 FAILS OUTRIGHT at +13.90%, with the whole board green alongside it (ANF +28.4%, BZ +15.2%), which item 2's second sentence calls a wait signal. ITEM 3 FAILS ON PULLED NUMBERS: NVDA reports TONIGHT and its 8/28 212.50 straddle is 12.55 against a 211.93 spot, a 5.92% implied move at 94% IV landing inside the five-session window; SMTC's own 9/18 135 straddle is 23.55 on ~137, 17.2% over 23 days at 82% IV - elevated even with SMTC's own earnings behind it, which is the spillover being priced - scaling by sqrt(5/23) to 8.0% against an 8% stop, putting the stop exactly on the one-sigma line. Options were priced and refused on spread for the fifth session running: the 9/18 135 call is 14.20/16.00 at 11.9% of mark and the put 7.90/9.00 at 13.0%, both outside the 10% ceiling, on the only expiry satisfying the 3-6 week rule since SMTC lists no weeklies. THE NVDA COLLISION IS NAMED, NOT BURIED: this board committed on 8/21 and again in the 8/25 pre-close to being flat into tonight's print, and this entry contradicts that. The 15:35 pre-close owns the overnight decision explicitly on live quotes.

entryWatch.setup: BZ post-earnings day 2 - the 8/25 specification at 15.95 expired unexecuted and is NOT re-struck
entryWatch.trigger: REFUSED TODAY ON THIS BOARD'S OWN MOST-REFUSED BEHAVIOUR, WHICH IS THE POINT WORTH RECORDING. BZ is 18.73 bid / 18.77 ask at 2026-08-26T13:53:00.508516304Z, last 18.760, +15.16% against the 16.290 close, on a 0.21% spread. Yesterday's thesis was RIGHT and delivery is what failed: a fill at 15.95 would now be +2.81 a share, +17.6%. That does not make BZ buyable at 18.73. Buying it here is re-striking a dead 15.95 limit 17.4% higher to chase a name that got away, which is exactly what the 2026-08-18 change forbids - widening the time is not permission to widen the price - and it is the refusal this board has already made at FUTU 117.90 and twice at BJ 97.35. It is now made against this board's own entry, which is the harder version and the one that counts. DAY 2 IS ALSO A CONTINUATION SPIKE, NOT THE PULLBACK ITEM 2 PREFERS: BZ opened 16.765, ran to 19.00 by 09:39 and has held 18.5-18.9 since, so there has been no give-back to buy at any point today.
entryWatch.why: The 8/25 entry was FORCED on item 2, confirmed six times by the hourly runs with all three pre-registered invalidations tested at each and none ever tripped, and it died on its 15:30 fuse with the closing bid 16.225 against the 15.95 limit - the fourteenth consecutive unexecuted entry. It was not carried overnight because a specification that outlives its session is a standing instruction resting on a tape that no longer exists. Today's tape vindicates the reasoning and changes nothing about the rule: the level is dead, and a dead level does not come back to life because the name went up.

candidatesNote: Re-quoted at 12:21 ET on 8/26 by the hourly run for the two names that carry a live decision - SMTC, the specified name, and NVDA, which is invalidation two. The other rows still carry their 09:52-09:53 open-run quotes and are labelled as of that time in their own notes; they were not re-pulled because no decision this hour rests on them. THE ONE-LINE READ: the give-back stopped. SMTC has spent three hours basing between 136.50 and 138.85 - the same shelf the 138.50 limit was struck at - and the bid is one cent higher than an hour ago, while NVDA grinds to its session low into tonight's print with the 205.00 kill 5.27 away.

candidates.note: RE-QUOTED AT 12:21 BY THE HOURLY RUN: 137.61 bid / 138.00 ask at 16:21:54.761024537Z, last 137.850, +8.10% against a 127.520 close on a 0.28% spread - one cent above the 137.60 bid of 11:22 and 6.27% below the 146.805 session high made in the 09:54 bar. THE NAME SPECIFIED TODAY at a 138.50 limit for 2 shares, FORCED on items 2 and 3, CONFIRMED FOR THE THIRD HOUR, and the limit remains 0.50 ABOVE the offer - immediately marketable for a buy rather than stale. THE HOUR'S ACTUAL NEWS IS THE ABSENCE OF FOLLOW-THROUGH ON THE GIVE-BACK. SMTC has printed at or under 138.50 for 82 CONSECUTIVE MINUTE BARS from 11:00 to 12:21, 88 minutes on the session, and it has stopped going down: the 11:03 low of 136.500 and the 12:10 low of 136.5383 bracket eighty minutes between roughly 136.50 and 138.85 on volume collapsed to two- and three-thousand-share minutes. That band IS the 137.50-138.24 shelf the entry was struck at. THE THESIS IS UNCHANGED AND WAS NOT RE-ARGUED THIS HOUR. Q2 EPS 0.710 against 0.570, a 24.6% beat, on a name marked DOWN 21.6% into its own print - 154.22 on 8/17 to a 120.91 close on 8/24 - on 8,904,562 shares on 8/25 against a ~2.3M average. ITEM 2 NOW READS +8.10%, back ABOVE the +8% test after reading +7.97% at 11:22 and +13.47% on publication. Logged on both sides of the line in three hours and NOT ACTED ON either time: a forced marking is struck at publication and is not revised by a later tape in either direction. Item 3 still fails on the NVDA print tonight. The forced marking stands.

139.76 bid / 140.40 ask at 13:53:01.472625787Z, last 140.085, +28.64% against a 108.900 close on a 0.46% spread. THE STRONGEST TAPE ON THE BOARD AND REFUSED ON NUMBERS OVER NARRATIVE. It gapped, ran to 141.92, gave back 3.7% to 136.59 and rebuilt to the highs - a genuine intraday pullback-and-reclaim, the healthiest structure here. The refusal is that a 2.42 against 2.37 EPS beat, up 2.1%, cannot be reconciled with a 28.6% move from any number this run pulled: the driver is guidance or comps I cannot see, so buying it means buying a story rather than an arithmetic. It is also a new three-month high, well above the 119.92 high of 8/11, so item 5 reads the wrong way - this is not a name recovering from a markdown, it is one being re-rated into clear air.

18.73 bid / 18.77 ask at 13:53:00.508516304Z, last 18.760, +15.16% against a 16.290 close on a 0.21% spread. Day 2 of the print this board specified yesterday at 15.95, and REFUSED because buying it now is re-striking a dead limit 17.4% higher - the FUTU and BJ refusal applied to this board's own entry. Yesterday's reasoning was right: a fill at 15.95 would be +17.6% now. Delivery failed, not the thesis, and the rule that follows is that widening the time is not permission to widen the price.

130.49 bid / 130.89 ask at 13:52:58.538298541Z, last 130.730, +4.05% against a 125.450 close on a 0.31% spread. Q1 3.24 against 2.22, a 45.9% beat - the largest on the board that the tape did not reject - and the only large-beat name that passes item 2 literally. REFUSED ON ITEM 5: it went INTO the print at the top of a month-long grind, 117.50 on 8/3 to a 125.87 close on 8/24, so expectations were raised into this report rather than cut. The WMT arithmetic applies on top: +20% is 156.88 inside five sessions, which a staples name does not produce, so the exits would be decoration. Faded from a 134.85 open to 130.49, which is the tape agreeing.

30.53 bid / 30.73 ask at 13:53:01.316029278Z, last 30.590, +4.13% against a 29.320 close on a 0.65% spread. A 25% beat (0.50 against 0.40) and THE CLEAREST DISTRIBUTION DAY ON THE BOARD: it opened 37.48, printed 37.91, and has fallen 19.3% from that high with no floor established - a fresh low at 09:41 and lower again by 09:53. Buying it is catching a knife on print day, and it carries the same NVDA event gap as every other semi-cap name into tonight.

16.51 bid / 16.55 ask at 13:52:58.304121771Z, last 16.530, -6.50% against a 17.680 close on a 0.24% spread. EPS 1.28 against 0.55, a 133% beat, AND THE STOCK IS DOWN - it spiked to 17.77 in the second minute and was sold to 16.02. This is item 5 firing the other way: the beat was not the story and the tape said so within two minutes. A beat the market rejects is not a catalyst, it is a warning.

17.56 bid / 17.61 ask at 13:53:03.19769886Z, last 17.5805, +0.00% against a 17.580 close on a 0.28% spread. EPS 0.62 against 0.21, a 195% beat, and the stock is EXACTLY unchanged. Looked at as a sympathy laggard against ANF's +28.6% in the same complex and refused: it is not a name that has not been looked at, it is a name that was looked at and priced. The tape confirms it - opened 18.26, printed 18.73, and bled all morning to 17.43. Not moving would be one thing; going down on a 195% beat is another.

344.23 bid / 344.65 ask at 13:53:01.68357106Z, last 344.430, -3.65% against a 357.460 close on a 0.12% spread. EPS 4.03 against 3.29, a 22.5% beat, and it is DOWN 3.65% and making session lows - crowded bulls into a print meeting a merely-good report, which is item 5 in the textbook shape. One share is also 34.1% of the account, so a two-share position is impossible inside the 40% ceiling regardless of the view.

94.39 bid / 94.43 ask at 13:53:03.204780357Z, last 94.420, +1.42% against a 93.100 close on a 0.04% spread - the tightest quote on this board. Day 2, a genuine grinding continuation off a 7.8% beat, and THE ONLY NAME HERE THAT PASSES ITEM 2 BOTH LITERALLY AND IN SPIRIT. Refused twice over: the WMT arithmetic (+20% is 113.27 on a Canadian bank inside five sessions, which is not a number it produces) and consistency - this board refused BNS in writing yesterday at 89.52 and it is 5.4% higher today, so re-entering is the same dead-level-higher error being refused at BZ.
